name: mail-inbox
description: IMAP mail as an inbox source. Polls a mailbox, surfaces messages from a fail-closed sender allowlist as inbox items, and extracts multipart/HTML/attachment text. Credentials live in the credential store, never in app config.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: IMAP Port
x-meta.help: IMAP port. 993 for implicit SSL (the default).

x-meta.label: Use SSL
x-meta.help: Connect with implicit TLS (IMAP4_SSL). Leave on for port 993.

x-meta.label: Username
x-meta.help: IMAP login (usually the full email address).

x-meta.label: Receiving Address
x-meta.help: The address mail arrives at — used as the inbox channel id. Defaults to the username when blank.

x-meta.label: Allowed Senders
x-meta.help: Glob patterns of From addresses permitted to trigger (e.g. alerts@*.example.com). EMPTY means fail-closed — nothing is surfaced at all.
